svg.aria-label: GraphDone: Relationship management for agents. People and AI agents coordinate through dependencies and outcomes.
svg.title: GraphDone: Relationship management for agents. People and AI agents coordinate through dependencies and outcomes.
svg.desc: GraphDone's current work as a live topology: work items from its open issues ride an orbit round their outcome, drawn as GraphDone's logo, each a node in its type's colour with an illustrative owner (a person or an AI agent) and named by a HUD callout with its issue number, over a perspective grid and drifting layers of distant graph. The items complete in dependency order: each node fills, its dependency arcs and its neon spoke to the outcome light and data pulses flow inward, and one of the logo's work nodes comes on; when every item is done the outcome locks and the readout reads 6/6 done.
